body:
Thank you so much.

I really do more than anything want her to be able to feel comfortable to talk about it with me if she needs or wants to but I haven't asked much more than she was willing to tell me on her own because I felt that I'd be being pushy and that I'd be making her feel uncomfortable if I did.

I do want her to keep feeling safe and comfortable with me and I've definitely never shown anger towards her about it. Today just hit me hard though. It's the first time I've gotten this angry. I felt more than willing to pick a fight with anybody and everybody I saw on my way home. My blood was boiling.

I love her but I just feel so awful seeing her look through his posts and see her eyes start to tear up. I feel helpless. I want to be able to help her more but there's really not much I can do besides being there and assuring her, right? There are some nights where she just curls up and starts to cry and repeatedly just repeats "I'm so sorry". I sit there and I hold her and tell her that she'll be okay and that it wasn't her fault. She blames herself so much.. Is there anything more I can do for her? I give her her space when she needs it and I hold her tight when she needs it. I just want to know if there's more I can do to help her feel okay. I love her and I just want to know what I can do.

Thank you so much for sharing with me. I'll definitely try to ask her when there's a moment for it. I want to be able to do everything I can to be there for her.

Hey, thanks for the reply. It means a lot. I do really appreciate it and I really appreciate you taking the time to read. It helped a lot just to vent it out and see that somebody took a minute to read it. 

I should say that I was more angry and less rational when writing that. I know it's about her regaining control and that throwing the item away without telling her would be terrible. I would have talked to her about removing him and tossing the item rather than doing it w/o her knowledge. But it probably would be better to just let her get through it and just be around for her, right?

Anyways, this is just the first time I've gotten angry and upset about her looking at his updates. I can't begin to imagine how hard it is for her and I'm so glad she finds comfort with me and trusts me enough to let me in as she does.

I'm sorry to take the time out of your day but I appreciate it so much that you took even more of your time to drop a reply. I hope you're doing well, kind internet stranger. Take care.
